meta.source: World Bank, Poverty and Inequality Platform (PIP)
meta.revisionPolicy: Each PIP release can revise any past estimate (new PPPs, new population figures, reprocessed surveys). The raw dump keeps every release.
meta.coverage: PIP surveys in the comparable spell 2022 to 2023: HCES 2022-2023, HCES 2023-2024
meta.note: Each date is a survey's reporting year (the survey's own period is in meta.surveys). Shares are per cent of people; money is 2021 PPP dollars a day per person. Poor counts are derived (headcount times population). Never join this spell to another.
